structured.answer: According to the page, I'd open an account at "פסגות" (marked "הזול") and buy the fund "אי.בי.אי. מחקה (4A) ת"א 125", number 5112628. With the page's own figures of 10,000 ₪ now and 500 ₪ a month for 120 months, that's 70,000 ₪ paid in and about 86,045 ₪ at the end. But I'm not doing anything until I talk to you, because Psagot isn't my bank and the page is full of minus signs.

stuck.why: "להשקיע במדד" – to me מדד is the price index on the news. If I hadn't had a task I'd have closed it, especially with the English letters MSCI and S&P right at the top.
The boxes already said 10,000 and 500, and there are sliders under them. I wasn't sure whether to type my own amounts or not, so I left them and kept the page's numbers.

stuck.where: Screen 2, the box next to my choice
stuck.why: "‎−1,030 ₪ לעומת הבחירה שלכם". I saw the minus and got a fright, as if I'd lose 1,030. I think it means the other one gives less, but I'm not sure.
My own big bank is only in the middle, around 81,000–83,000, and the cheapest is Psagot. I don't know them like I know my bank, and I hesitated over whether to move my money there.
Every fund has a minus: ‎−0.04%, ‎−0.37%, ‎−1,733 ₪. To me that looks like they all lose money. That's where I got worried and stopped.

findings.what: Minus signs on every fund and on the comparison box (‎−0.04%, ‎−1,030 ₪). They look like losses and scare you away, even though they seem to be a difference compared with something else.
findings.where: Screen 2 (the next-best pair) and screens 7–8 (the fund list)

findings.what: The heading talks about "מדד" without explaining that it means shares on the stock exchange. To someone my age, מדד is the price index.
The first buttons are in English (MSCI World, S&P 500). It feels like the page isn't for me.
Dark background with grey writing. The small grey lines ("הבחירה שלכם; האתר לא ממליץ על מדד", "קרנות ישראליות...") are hard to read even enlarged.
There are sliders under the amount boxes, and the boxes already have numbers in them. It isn't clear whether to type in your own.
There's no word about risk, and nothing comparing it with a deposit. Someone used to deposits has nothing to hold on to.
findings.where: Whole page as far as I read

findings.what: The round arrow button covers the writing at the end of the lines
The coloured strips have close colours (orange/yellow/red), and I can't tell which is which
Too many numbers one after another in the bank list. It's tiring and makes you anxious.
It isn't clear who "מקור" is or why I should trust them
